title: Goan Pork Vindaloo

ingredientGroups.title: Pork
items: 2.5 lbs pork butt, cut into chunks

steps: Heat 3 Tbsp neutral oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat.  Working in 3-4 batches, sear the pork chunks until lightly browned, then set aside.  Do not overcrowd the pot, or the pork will steam instead of developing flavor through the maillard reaction.  Remove the pork before a hard crust develops.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the diced onions.  Saute for 6-8 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Add a small pinch of salt, along with the garlic and ginger, and saute for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Reduce the heat slightly (medium to medium-low) and add the spice mix.  Stir continuously, for 30-60 seconds to bloom the spices.  The mixture should become very aromatic with a warm, deep fragrance.
Return the pork to the pot along with any accumulated juices.  Add the seasoned vinegar, 1.5 cups water, 3-4 Tbsp brown sugar, and 1.5 tsp kosher salt.  Stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and reduce heat to low.  Cook for 75 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Remove the lid and simmer uncovered for 10-20 minutes, until the sauce reduces to a thick, glossy consistency that coats the back of a spoon.  If needed, lightly mash a few pork pieces to help thicken the sauce.
Taste and adjust seasoning: Add a splash of vinegar for brightness Add a small amount of brown sugar for sweetness Adjust salt as needed.
Serve immediately, or preferably rest overnight in the refrigerator to develop a more cohesive, deeper, and smoother flavor.  Reheat gently with a splash of water to loosen the sauce.
Finish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro and serve with the rice.
headnote: This untested draft recipe attempts to replicate the Central Market Goan Pork Vindaloo with Jasmine rice.  The dish is an americanized adaptation of a traditional Goan Vindaloo, reducing the heat and sour notes for approachability, then balancing with a mild sweetness.  Leftovers hold well and reheat quickly, making a nice packed lunch.

components.title: Vindaloo Spice Mix

items: 1 tsp chili powder (can increase to 2 tsp)

steps: Toast all the spices over medium heat for 30-60 seconds and set aside.  Alternatively, bake them in the oven on a sheet pan at 250-275 degrees F for 15 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes then grind into a fine powder.

components.title: Jasmine Rice
steps: Rinse 2 cups jasmine rice and cook per rice cooker’s directions (typically 1:1 to 1:1.25)
Fold remaining ingredients into the rice while it is still warm.

sourceNote: This clone is designed to replicate Central Market’s Pork Vindaloo With Jasmine Rice Dinner For One. https://www.centralmarket.com/holiday-meals-closed/product/central-market-pork-vindaloo-with-jasmine-rice-dinner-for-one-ea/1800631
